description.value: JV Convenience Store is a neighborhood shop on Dewdney Trunk Road in Maple Ridge specializing in exotic snacks and drinks sourced from around the world, alongside everyday household essentials. The store carries an eclectic mix of international candies, chips, glass-bottled beverages, energy drinks, Mexican snacks, and treats like mini donuts and screamers. Cyclists passing through Maple Ridge on this busy commercial corridor would find it a useful stop for an unusual variety of snacks and refreshments.
